SELECT COALESCE(smt.target_contract_count, 0) AS targetContractCount,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract c WHERE c.sales_user_id = #{salesUserId} AND c.contract_result_status_code = '02' AND DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m') ) AS completedContractCount,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(smt.target_contract_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( ( ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contract c WHERE c.sales_user_id = #{salesUserId} AND c.contract_result_status_code = '02' AND DATE_FORMAT(c.updated_at, '%Y%m') = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m') ) * 100.0 ) / smt.target_contract_count ) END AS achievementRate
FROM sales_monthly_target smt WHERE smt.sales_user_id = #{salesUserId} AND smt.target_year_month = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m')
